notes_sections.heading: Per-query audit
items: Platform Engineer — 13 results, all 13 reviewed (full list rendered via accessibility tree, not just the visible cards). Complete.
Site Reliability Engineer — 2 results, both reviewed (both duplicates of postings already captured under other keywords). Complete.
Cloud Engineer — 15 results, 14 unique postings identified and reviewed by title/detail (one may have been a rendering duplicate not distinctly captured). Complete.
DevSecOps Engineer — 0 results ("We're unable to find any jobs matching your search"). Zero results.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, login wall, or blocking page encountered on any query.

notes_sections.heading: Search noise excluded from the table
items: The Platform Engineer and Cloud Engineer keywords pull in a lot of full-text keyword-matched noise with no real SRE/Platform/DevOps center of gravity, not individually rowed here (consistent with prior runs): Python/Spark Developer (Mississauga), Junior AI Engineer (Markham), Senior AI Engineer (Calgary and Vancouver), Senior Embedded Software Engineer – Automotive C++/Linux (Ottawa), Embedded C++ Software Engineer – Android Automotive/AOSP (Ottawa), Programmer Analyst – Senior at Bank of Montreal (Toronto), AI Engineer / Solution Lead ($150K–$180K/yr, Toronto), Ingénieur(e) analytique junior/Junior Analytics Engineer (Quebec City), Principal Data Architect (Mississauga), Junior Security Engineer (Markham), Data Engineer and Senior Data Engineer (Mississauga/Calgary), Unified Communication Voice Specialist III (Vancouver), and Senior Project/Solutions Engineer (Houston, TX — also US-ineligible).

Procom's inventory this run skews heavily toward AI/ML engineering, data engineering, and embedded-automotive roles rather than infrastructure/platform/reliability work — a continuation of the drift noted in the 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-19 runs.

Browser-driven throughout; the real contractor portal (myprocom-portal.procomservices.com) loaded cleanly with no login needed. The naive-text-extraction trap (get_page_text returning only chrome, not card content) was confirmed again — read_page's accessibility tree and screenshots were used instead to capture full result lists, including lazily-rendered cards beyond the first visible few.

method: Six-keyword default rotation (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer) run browser-driven against the real contractor portal. 21 unique postings encountered and reviewed across the four keywords that returned results; two returned zero results outright. Zero eligible target-family postings scored 5 or above this run — the one known pipeline match (Flextrack Salesforce DevOps Engineer) remains Skipped per applications.md. Two new out-of-scope/ineligible postings identified (a Toronto-hybrid CyberArk/PKI security-platform role, and a Toronto-hybrid MCAP systems-engineer role outside the reachable-city range), plus confirmation that a previously logged QA Automation Engineer posting has been removed from the portal. No jobs qualified for automatic filing this run.
